sloka: श्रुत्वा एव उपस्थितौ वीरौ कदा अयोध्या भविष्यति ।यशस्विनी हृष्ट जना सूच्च्रित ध्वज मालिनी ॥२-४३-१०॥
transliteration: śrutvā eva upasthitau vīrau kadā ayodhyā bhaviṣyati ।yaśasvinī hṛṣṭa janā sūccrita dhvaja mālinī ॥2-43-10॥

translations.english: When will the city of Ayodhya attain that glory when having heard that both the brave brothers have come back the people will rejoice and fill it with uplifted banners?
